AddInstanceWhiteList.description_en: Adds an instance whitelist. Only new-architecture instances are supported, that is, instances whose VPC access point (or VPC PrivateLink access point) ends with mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com
AddInstanceWhiteList.description_zh:
增加实例白名单
只支持新架构实例，即VPC接入点（或者VPC PrivateLink 接入点）以mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com结尾的实例

CreateAccount.description_en: When an open-source client accesses an ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ server, it must provide a username and password for authentication. ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ lets you generate a username and password from an AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret provided by Resource Access Management (RAM)
CreateAccount.description_zh: 开源客户端访问云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版服务端时，需要传入用户名和密码进行权限认证，认证通过才允许访问服务端。云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版支持通过阿里云访问控制（RAM）的AccessKey和AccessKey Secret生成用户名和密码

CreateBinding.description_en: A producer sends a message to an exchange, which then routes the message to a specified queue or another exchange based on the binding and routing rules
CreateBinding.description_zh: Producer将消息发送到Exchange，Exchange根据创建的绑定关系以及路由规则选择将消息路由到指定的Queue或其他Exchange中

CreateExchange.description_en: A producer sends a message to an exchange. The exchange then routes the message to one or more queues based on the routing key and the binding key, or discards the message
CreateExchange.description_zh: Producer将消息发送到Exchange，由Exchange将消息路由到一个或多个Queue中（或者丢弃）。Exchange根据Routing Key和Binding Key将消息路由到Queue

CreateInstance.description_en: Creates an ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance
CreateInstance.description_zh: 创建云消息队列RabbitMQ的实例

CreateOpenSourceAccount.description_en: Creates an open-source username and password

CreateQueue.description_en: A queue is a buffer that stores messages. In ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ, messages are sent to a specified exchange and then routed to a bound queue
CreateQueue.description_zh: Queue是指消息队列，云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版的消息都会被发送至指定的Exchange，再由Exchange路由至绑定的Queue中

CreateVirtualHost.description_en: Creates a vhost. A vhost is used to logically isolate resources. Each vhost manages its own exchanges, queues, and bindings. Applications can run on independent vhosts in a secure manner. This way, the business of an application is not affected by other applications. Before you connect producers and consumers to an ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance, you must specify vhosts for the producers and consumers
CreateVirtualHost.description_zh: Vhost是指虚拟主机，用作逻辑隔离，分别管理各自的Exchange、Queue和Binding，使得应用安全地运行在不同的Vhost上，相互之间不会干扰。Producer和Consumer连接云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版需要指定一个Vhost

DeleteAccount.description_en: Deletes a static username and password

DeleteBinding.description_en: The DeleteBinding operation detaches a source exchange from a target queue or another exchange
DeleteBinding.description_zh: 调用DeleteBinding解除源Exchange与目标Queue或者其他Exchange的绑定关系

DeleteInstance.description_en: Deletes an ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance
DeleteInstance.description_zh: 删除云消息队列RabbitMQ的实例

DeleteOpenSourceAccount.description_en: Deletes the username and password of an open-source user

GetInstance.description_en: Retrieves the details of an ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance
GetInstance.description_zh: 获取云消息队列RabbitMQ的实例

GetMetadataAmount.description_en: Queries the current and maximum numbers of vhosts, exchanges, and queues for a specified ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance
GetMetadataAmount.description_zh: 查看指定云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例下可创建的Vhost、Exchange、Queue的最大数量以及当前已创建的数量

ListAccounts.description_en: Lists the usernames and passwords for a specified ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance
ListAccounts.description_zh: 查看指定云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例的用户名密码

ListBindings.description_en: Queries all bindings that are created in a vhost of a specified ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance
ListBindings.description_zh: 查询指定云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例下某一Vhost内所有创建的绑定关系

ListDownStreamBindings.description_en: Queries the exchanges or queues that are bound to a specified exchange
ListDownStreamBindings.description_zh: 查询指定Exchange绑定了哪些Exchange或Queue

ListExchangeUpStreamBindings.description_en: Queries the queues or other exchanges that are bound to a specified exchange
ListExchangeUpStreamBindings.description_zh: 查询指定Exchange被哪些Queue或者其他Exchange绑定

ListExchanges.description_en: Lists all exchanges in a specified vhost of an instance
ListExchanges.description_zh: 查询指定实例下某一Vhost内创建的所有Exchange

ListInstanceWhiteList.description_en: Queries the IP or VPC whitelist of an instance. Only new-architecture instances are supported, that is, instances whose VPC access point (or VPC PrivateLink access point) ends with mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com
ListInstanceWhiteList.description_zh:
查询实例ip/vpc白名单；
只支持新架构实例，即VPC接入点（或者VPC PrivateLink 接入点）以mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com结尾的实例

ListInstances.description_en: Queries a list of ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instances in a specified region and returns basic information about each instance, such as its endpoints and specification limits
ListInstances.description_zh: 查询指定地域下的云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例列表以及各实例的基本信息，包括实例接入点、实例规格上限等信息

ListQueueConsumers.description_en: Queries the online consumer clients of a specified queue
ListQueueConsumers.description_zh: 查询指定Queue的在线Consumer客户端

ListQueueUpStreamBindings.description_en: Queries the exchanges that are bound to a specified queue

ListQueues.description_en: Queries information about all queues in a vhost on a specified ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance
ListQueues.description_zh: 查询指定云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例下某一Vhost内的所有Queue信息

ListVirtualHosts.description_en: Lists all vhosts in a specified ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance
ListVirtualHosts.description_zh: 查询指定云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例下所有的Vhost

RemoveInstanceWhiteList.description_en: Deletes an IP or VPC whitelist entry for an instance. This operation supports only new-architecture instances whose VPC access points (or VPC PrivateLink access points) end with mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com
RemoveInstanceWhiteList.description_zh:
删除实例ip/vpc白名单；
只支持新架构实例，即VPC接入点（或者VPC PrivateLink 接入点）以mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com结尾的实例

UpdateInstance.description_en: Updates an ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance to upgrade or downgrade its specifications
UpdateInstance.description_zh: 更新云消息队列RabbitMQ的实例，升降配规格

UpdateInstanceName.description_en: An ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance is named after its instance ID by default. You can change the name for easier identification
UpdateInstanceName.description_zh: 云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例后，实例名称默认为实例ID，您可以自定义修改实例名称，方便区分实例

UpdateOpenSourceAccount.description_en: Updates the username and password for open-source access
